info.name: Vita Backend API Collection (via API Gateway)
info.description: Complete API collection for Vita Backend microservices - All APIs are called through API Gateway for centralized routing, authentication, and monitoring

request.description: Login with username and password to get JWT token (via API Gateway)
Validate and get information from JWT token (via API Gateway)
Refresh JWT token (via API Gateway)
Logout and invalidate JWT token (via API Gateway)
Validate JWT token (via API Gateway)
Create a new user account (via API Gateway)
Create a new admin user account (via API Gateway)
Get current user information (via API Gateway)
Update user information (via API Gateway)
Get all users (requires ADMIN role) (via API Gateway)
Get user by ID (requires ADMIN role) (via API Gateway)
Delete user by ID (requires ADMIN role) (via API Gateway)
Create a new role (via API Gateway)
Get all available roles (via API Gateway)
Delete a role by name (via API Gateway)
Check if admin account exists (via API Gateway)
List all admin users (requires ADMIN role) (via API Gateway)
Create user profile in user service (via API Gateway)
Get user profile by ID (via API Gateway)

Create a new post (via API Gateway). Requires authentication - JWT token will be validated and user ID will be automatically extracted from the token. You can optionally specify postTypeId or postTypeCode.
Get all posts (via API Gateway). This is a public endpoint - no authentication required. You can filter by postTypeId or postTypeCode.
Get post by ID (via API Gateway). This is a public endpoint - no authentication required.

Update post by ID (via API Gateway). Requires authentication - JWT token will be validated and user ID will be automatically extracted. Only the post author or admin can update the post. You can optionally update postTypeId or postTypeCode.
Delete post by ID (via API Gateway). Requires authentication - JWT token will be validated. Only the post author or admin can delete the post.

Create a new post type (via API Gateway). Requires ADMIN role authentication. Code must be uppercase with only letters and underscores. Both name and code must be unique. User ID will be automatically recorded as createdBy.
Get all post types (via API Gateway). This is a public endpoint - no authentication required. You can filter by isActive parameter.
Get post type by ID (via API Gateway). This is a public endpoint - no authentication required.
Get post type by code (via API Gateway). This is a public endpoint - no authentication required. Example code: SHARE, NEWS, ADVICE

Update post type by ID (via API Gateway). Requires ADMIN role authentication. All fields are optional. If updating name or code, they must still be unique. User ID will be automatically recorded as updatedBy.
Delete post type by ID (via API Gateway). Requires ADMIN role authentication. Cannot delete a post type that is being used by any posts. Returns 409 Conflict if post type is in use.

request.description: Create a new rental listing (via API Gateway). Requires authentication. Owner ID is automatically extracted from JWT token. Property types: APARTMENT, HOUSE, STUDIO, VILLA, ROOM, LAND.
Get all rental listings (via API Gateway). Public endpoint - no authentication required.
Get current user's rental listings (via API Gateway). Requires authentication.
Get rental listing by ID (via API Gateway). Public endpoint - no authentication required.
Update rental listing (via API Gateway). Requires authentication. Only owner can update. All fields are optional.
Update rental status (via API Gateway). Requires authentication. Only owner can update. Statuses: AVAILABLE, RENTED, INACTIVE.
Delete rental listing (via API Gateway). Requires authentication. Only owner can delete.

query.description: Filter by property type (APARTMENT, HOUSE, STUDIO, VILLA, ROOM, LAND)

request.description: Search and filter rental listings (via API Gateway). Public endpoint. All parameters are optional. Returns only AVAILABLE rentals.

Send a rental request to property owner (via API Gateway). Requires authentication. Renter ID is automatically extracted from JWT token. Cannot request your own rental. One pending request per rental.
Get rental request by ID (via API Gateway). Public endpoint.
Get current user's rental requests (via API Gateway). Requires authentication.
Get all requests for a rental (via API Gateway). Requires authentication. Only rental owner can access.
Update rental request status (via API Gateway). Requires authentication. Only rental owner can update. Statuses: ACCEPTED, REJECTED. For REJECTED, include rejectionReason field.
Reject rental request with reason (via API Gateway). Requires authentication. Only rental owner can reject.
Cancel rental request (via API Gateway). Requires authentication. Only the renter who created the request can cancel. Can only cancel PENDING requests.
Create a review for a rental (via API Gateway). Requires authentication. Reviewer ID is automatically extracted from JWT token. Rating must be 1-5. Cannot review your own rental.
Get all reviews for a rental (via API Gateway). Public endpoint. Returns reviews ordered by creation date (newest first).
Get review by ID (via API Gateway). Public endpoint.
Get average rating for a rental (via API Gateway). Public endpoint. Returns 0 if no reviews.
Update review (via API Gateway). Requires authentication. Only the reviewer can update. Rating must be 1-5.
Delete review (via API Gateway). Requires authentication. Only the reviewer can delete.
Get all rentals with pagination (via API Gateway). Requires ADMIN role authentication.
Update any rental status (via API Gateway). Requires ADMIN role authentication. Statuses: AVAILABLE, RENTED, INACTIVE, PENDING_APPROVAL, REJECTED.
Check API Gateway health status
Get cache statistics from API Gateway
Request presigned URL for uploading an image to S3. Returns uploadUrl for direct S3 upload and fileId for confirmation.
Request presigned URL for uploading a video to S3. Max size: 100MB.
Confirm that file has been uploaded to S3. This verifies the file exists and marks upload as COMPLETED.
Get media details by file ID
Get all media uploaded by current user with pagination

Cleanup expired pending uploads (Admin only). Marks expired uploads as FAILED.
